description: This file contains the implementation of a Promise class following the Promises/A+ specification, including methods for handling asynchronous operations, resolution, rejection, cancellation, and chaining of promises.

classes.name: Promise
classes.description: Implementation of a Promise object for asynchronous operations, supporting chaining, resolution, rejection, cancellation, and state management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the promise with optional wait and cancel functions.

methods.name: then
methods.description: Attaches fulfillment and rejection handlers to the promise, returning a new chained promise.

methods.name: otherwise
methods.description: Attaches a rejection handler to the promise.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Blocks until the promise is resolved or rejected, optionally unwrapping the result.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the promise ('PENDING', 'FULFILLED', or 'REJECTED').

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels the promise if it is pending, invoking the cancel function if provided.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Fulfills the promise with a given value.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Rejects the promise with a given reason.

methods.name: settle
methods.description: Internal method to set the promise's state and handle handlers accordingly.

methods.name: callHandler
methods.description: Static method to execute a handler callback with proper error handling.

methods.name: waitIfPending
methods.description: Internal method to invoke wait functions or wait list if the promise is pending.

methods.name: invokeWaitFn
methods.description: Internal method to execute the wait function.

methods.name: invokeWaitList
methods.description: Internal method to wait on a list of promises.
